title: Professional Data Workbench
category: Professional SaaS / bulk data / campaigns / Teams
summary: Launches Watchdog's plan-aware professional Data Workbench as a real JavaScript application for Agent, Pro, Pro+ and Teams. Paid users can work across saved properties, Saved Farms and Opportunity Desk records; choose, reorder and sort governed fields; apply advanced property and intelligence filters; page through server-backed farm datasets; hydrate available marker observations; save personal or Teams-shared workspaces; check FEMA flood zones; and turn selected properties into CRM, direct-mail, mailing-label, mail-merge and privacy-safe online-ad exports. Pro+ and Teams retain access to the full governed marker catalog while lower plans receive only their entitled fields.

items.detail: Added /property/data-workbench.html as a JavaScript-driven data application mounted in the Watchdog shell, with professional grid behavior, sortable and draggable columns, row selection, searchable field library and 25/50/100/250/500/1000 row views.

Workbench sources now include My Properties, Saved Farms and Opportunity Desk. Saved Farms reuse the existing municipal-data, farm-map-query and farm-intelligence-scan server contracts with paginated loading rather than downloading whole statewide datasets into the browser.

The app reads the live get_agent_usage() plan contract. Agent sees Standard plus agent-relevant Pro fields, Pro sees Standard + Pro, and Pro+/Teams/Developer can use the complete governed marker catalog. Standard accounts are routed to plan selection.

Farm intelligence metrics and per-user score_observations are merged into Workbench rows so connected Watchdog markers can be sorted, filtered and exported without inventing values for unavailable fields.
Added town/county, assessment, annual tax, Watchdog value, year built, Watchdog Score, Chapter 123 annual-impact and FEMA flood-risk filtering plus free-text filtering and sortable columns.

Selected properties can be persisted as campaign drafts and exported as CRM-ready files, direct-mail files, mailing labels, mail-merge files or privacy-safe property/geography audiences for online advertising.

Added dedicated RLS-protected data_workbench_views and data_workbench_campaigns persistence. Agent/Pro/Pro+/Teams may save personal views; Teams organization members can share Workbench views through existing organization membership boundaries.
Workbench includes FEMA Flood Zone and Flood Risk columns backed by the production FEMA NFHL lookup service and supports bulk checks for visible properties with coordinates.

Data Workbench is exposed in desktop and mobile Professional Work navigation for every paid plan. The deeper Data Center field catalog remains separate and is now correctly gated to Pro+ rather than Developer-only.

Vercel production builds reached READY; /property/data-workbench.html and its JavaScript/CSS assets return HTTP 200; the RLS policies and can_use_data_workbench entitlement function are present in production Supabase; the Pro+ Data Center entitlement is aligned with the product contract.
